import polars as pl
import re
from datetime import datetime
import math


def parse_phone_e164(s: pl.Expr, default_country: str = "64") -> pl.Expr:
    digits = s.str.replace_all(r"\D", "")
    return pl.when(digits.str.len_chars() > 0).then(
        pl.when(digits.str.starts_with("0"))
        .then(pl.lit("+" + default_country) + digits.str.slice(1))
        .otherwise(pl.lit("+") + digits)
    ).otherwise(None)


def transform(raw: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    missing_vals = ["", "N/A", "n/a", "-", "null", "NULL", "None"]

    return raw.select(
        contact_id=pl.col("Record ID").str.to_uppercase(),
        full_name=pl.concat_str([pl.col("First Name"), pl.col("Last Name")], separator=" "),
        email=pl.when(pl.col("E-mail").is_in(missing_vals))
        .then(None)
        .otherwise(pl.col("E-mail").str.to_lowercase()),
        phone=parse_phone_e164(pl.col("Mobile")),
        company=pl.col("Organisation"),
        created_on=pl.col("Date Created").str.to_date("%d-%b-%Y", strict=False),
        lifetime_value=pl.col("Total Spend")
        .str.replace_all(r"[\$,]", "")
        .cast(pl.Float64, strict=False)
        .round(2),
    )
